correctness.rationale: Direct local fort constraints determine forced pendant mates. Any outside vertex with at least three neighbors in a minimal tree fort admits branch pruning. A disconnected two-step link allows a proper nonempty fort subset; a connected link forces all selected core vertices into any contained fort, so no proper subfort. The path case yields parity arithmetic progressions, a closed weighted interval sum, and an exact quadratic count; independent exhaustive calculations are recorded.

value.rationale: An exact minimal-fort hypergraph is the irredundant obstruction family in zero forcing. For comb trees the result gives every minimal obstruction and its size, with a quadratic obstruction count despite at least 2^n−1 forts. A sharp natural infinite-family cardinality profile and a general whiskered-tree structural criterion have independent mathematical use.
